hermeticity.method: I formed the baseline from the focus ayah and its three complete focus-root inventories, then tested the context_root_cues in packet order. Retained context models remain attached to a focus word or construction, and packet-supplied images are separated from reader-supplied causal arrows.
hermeticity.limitations: This is a reconstructed focus trace rather than a strict staged discovery log because the sealed packet exposed the focus and all context together. No source beyond the prompt, response schema, and assigned packet was used, so the models record packet-bounded activations rather than a final interpretation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The rhetorical أَفَلَا and temporal إِذَا place knowing at an event-threshold: earth is overturned, the buried are disclosed, and what was unavailable becomes clear to a knower. The packet supplies disclosure and burial; I infer that the event changes the knower's epistemic position.

discarded_or_unchanged: The burning, blackening, and ash images for ضَبْحًا at root_000901/B003, root_000901/B004, and root_000901/B005 colored the scene but did not independently change a focus-anchored mechanism.
The drinking-vessel, plant, animal-name, body-part, and place-name branches across the packet generally failed to attach to يَعْلَمُ, بُعْثِرَ, or قُبُورِ with a changed reading.
صُبْحًا by itself merely repeated the baseline of visibility; it was retained only when coupled to latent fire, striking, and changed form in delta_ignition_dawn.
The justice, moderation, and mediation images under وَسَطْ did not improve the center-and-reassembly mechanism supplied by root_001646/B003 and root_000259/B001.
The concrete cloud, flock, food, and plant images in the ر ب ب inventory remained unchanged because they did not sharpen either relational culpability or epistemic asymmetry.
The soil and cultivation images under خَبِيرٌ tempted an earth/seed extension but repeated the stronger seed-latency outlier without adding a distinct focus mechanism.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from simple exhumation to a collapse of container topology: inside becomes outside and bottom becomes top.
100:4 revised easy visibility into trace-based knowing through a dust-obscured, disordered evidentiary field.
100:10 made grave-opening the outward half of a two-stage assay: external contents are dispersed, then inward causes are gathered and extracted.
100:6-7 and 100:11 produced coexisting epistemic readings: culpable human self-witness, belated recognition at exposure, and prior sovereign knowledge of inward reality.
Split and branch-distant cues preserved live alternatives of return after departure, seed-like latency, attraction from a burrow, and vertical rising.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly made disclosure non-simple. Running could reverse into return; sparks and dawn converted latency into manifestation; dust both hid and preserved traces; scattering prepared reassembly; desire both confined and lured outward; and the syntactic twin in 100:10 reversed dispersal into core extraction. The most productive surprise was that يَعْلَمُ could remain ordinary knowing while its mechanism shifted among direct unveiling, mark-reading, self-witness, and asymmetrical access.
remaining_uncertainties: The rhetorical subject's temporal state remains open: present knowing, refused recognition, and future forced knowing can coexist.
The scope of مَا فِي ٱلْقُبُورِ remains broader than a single decision between occupants, bodies, traces, or records.
The reassembly model depends on reading gathering and scattering as a sequence rather than merely opposed scenes.
The return, seed, burrow-lure, fluid-container, and vertical models are genuine packet activations but remain form-distant analogies, not lexical replacements.
The causal arrows from disturbance to evidence and from outer exposure to inner assay are abductive; the packet supplies the paired elements but not every direction asserted.
